recipes.name: Palak Paneer
method_steps: Blanch the spinach for two minutes, then blend to a smooth puree.
Fry the onion, ginger and garlic until golden.
Add tomato and garam masala; cook until the oil separates.
Stir in the spinach puree and simmer for five minutes.
Fold in the paneer cubes and finish with cream.

recipes.name: Aloo Gobi
method_steps: Cut the potato and cauliflower into even florets and cubes.
Temper cumin in hot oil until it crackles.
Add the potato, cover and cook until half done.
Add cauliflower, turmeric and salt; cook uncovered until edges brown.
Finish with coriander.

recipes.name: Vegetable Pulao
method_steps: Rinse and soak the rice for twenty minutes.
Fry whole spices and onion in ghee until fragrant.
Add the mixed vegetables and saute briefly.
Add rice and water at one to one and a half, then bring to a boil.
Cover and cook on low for twelve minutes, then rest before fluffing.

recipes.name: Paneer Bhurji
method_steps: Crumble the paneer coarsely.
Saute onion, green chilli and ginger until soft.
Add tomato and cook until pulpy.
Stir in the crumbled paneer and turmeric; cook two minutes.
Finish with coriander and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.name: Avocado Toast
method_steps: Toast the bread until crisp.
Mash the avocado with salt and lemon.
Spread thickly and top with chilli flakes.

recipes.name: Jeera Aloo
method_steps: Boil and cube the potatoes.
Crackle cumin in hot oil.
Toss the potatoes with turmeric and salt until coated.
Finish with coriander.

recipes.name: Palak Dal
method_steps: Pressure cook the toor dal until soft.
Saute garlic, cumin and green chilli.
Add chopped spinach and wilt.
Combine with the dal and simmer ten minutes.

recipes.name: Tomato Rasam
method_steps: Simmer tomato with turmeric and salt.
Add cooked toor dal and water.
Temper cumin and curry leaves; pour over.
Finish with coriander.

recipes.name: Bhindi Masala
method_steps: Wash and dry the okra completely, then slice.
Fry until the sliminess disappears.
Add onion and tomato; cook down.
Season with garam masala and salt.

recipes.name: Baingan Bharta
method_steps: Char the brinjal directly over flame until collapsed.
Peel and mash the smoked flesh.
Fry onion, ginger, garlic and tomato.
Fold in the mashed brinjal and cook until dry.
Finish with coriander.

recipes.name: Poha
method_steps: Rinse the poha briefly and drain.
Temper mustard, curry leaves and green chilli.
Add onion and potato; cook through.
Fold in the poha with turmeric and salt.
Finish with lemon and coriander.

recipes.name: Besan Chilla
method_steps: Whisk besan with water to a pourable batter.
Stir in onion, tomato, chilli and coriander.
Ladle onto a hot pan and spread thin.
Cook both sides until golden.

recipes.name: Masala Omelette
method_steps: Beat the eggs with salt.
Add onion, tomato, chilli and coriander.
Cook on a hot pan, folding once.

recipes.name: Matar Paneer
method_steps: Blend onion and tomato into a smooth base.
Cook the base until the oil separates.
Add peas and simmer until tender.
Add paneer and garam masala; rest before serving.

recipes.name: Cabbage Poriyal
method_steps: Shred the cabbage finely.
Temper mustard, curry leaves and chana dal.
Add cabbage and cook uncovered until just tender.

recipes.name: Lauki Sabzi
method_steps: Peel and cube the bottle gourd.
Temper cumin, then add tomato and turmeric.
Add the gourd, cover and cook until soft.

recipes.name: Carrot Halwa
method_steps: Grate the carrots finely.
Cook in milk until the liquid reduces almost fully.
Add sugar and ghee; cook until glossy.
Finish with cashews.

recipes.name: Cucumber Raita
method_steps: Whisk the curd smooth.
Grate the cucumber and squeeze out excess water.
Fold together with cumin and salt.

recipes.name: Boondi Kadhi
method_steps: Whisk curd with besan and turmeric until lump-free.
Simmer gently, stirring, for twenty minutes.
Temper cumin and curry leaves; pour over.

recipes.name: Mushroom Masala
method_steps: Clean and quarter the mushrooms.
Fry onion, ginger and garlic until golden.
Add tomato and cook down.
Add mushrooms and cook until they release and reabsorb their liquid.

recipes.name: Paneer Tikka
method_steps: Marinate paneer and capsicum in spiced curd for twenty minutes.
Thread onto skewers with onion.
Grill or pan-sear until charred at the edges.
Finish with lemon.

recipes.name: Dal Tadka
method_steps: Pressure cook toor dal with turmeric until soft.
Heat ghee and crackle cumin, garlic and chilli.
Pour the tempering over the dal.
Finish with coriander.

recipes.name: Moong Dal Khichdi
method_steps: Rinse rice and moong dal together.
Pressure cook with turmeric, salt and water.
Temper cumin in ghee and stir through.

recipes.name: Vegetable Upma
method_steps: Dry roast the poha lightly.
Temper mustard, curry leaves and chana dal.
Add onion, carrot and peas; cook briefly.
Add water, then fold in the poha and cook covered.

recipes.name: Tomato Onion Salad
method_steps: Slice tomato, onion and cucumber thinly.
Dress with lemon, salt and coriander.

recipes.name: Aloo Paratha
method_steps: Boil, peel and mash the potatoes.
Season with chilli, coriander and salt.
Stuff into atta dough rounds and roll gently.
Cook on a hot tawa with ghee until spotted.

recipes.name: Chana Dal Sundal
method_steps: Soak and boil the chana dal until just firm.
Temper mustard, curry leaves and chilli.
Toss the dal through and season.

recipes.name: Paneer Butter Masala
method_steps: Blend tomato, cashew, ginger and garlic into a smooth base.
Cook the base in butter until deep red.
Add cream and garam masala.
Fold in paneer and finish with kasuri methi.

recipes.name: Green Beans Stir Fry
method_steps: Trim and chop the beans small.
Temper mustard and chana dal.
Add beans with a splash of water and cook covered until tender.

recipes.name: Masala Chai
method_steps: Boil water with crushed ginger and tea leaves.
Add milk and sugar; bring to a rolling boil.
Strain and serve.

recipes.name: Banana Smoothie
method_steps: Blend banana, curd and milk until smooth.
Sweeten with jaggery to taste.

recipes.name: Apple Cinnamon Porridge
method_steps: Simmer poha in milk until thickened.
Grate in the apple and sweeten with jaggery.

recipes.name: Cheese Toast
method_steps: Butter the bread lightly.
Layer cheese, tomato and chilli.
Grill until bubbling.

recipes.name: Capsicum Rice
method_steps: Cook and cool the rice.
Saute capsicum and onion until blistered.
Fold the rice through with garam masala.

recipes.name: Spinach Soup
method_steps: Wilt the spinach with garlic.
Blend smooth with a little milk.
Reheat gently and season.

recipes.name: Frozen Peas Pulao
method_steps: Soak the rice twenty minutes.
Fry onion and whole spices in ghee.
Add frozen peas straight from the freezer.
Add rice and water; cook covered on low.

recipes.name: Curd Rice
method_steps: Mash warm cooked rice with curd and salt.
Temper mustard, curry leaves and chilli.
Stir through and rest before serving.

recipes.name: Guava Chaat
method_steps: Cube the guava.
Toss with lemon, salt and cumin.

recipes.name: Mango Lassi
method_steps: Blend mango with curd and sugar.
Thin with a little milk and chill.

recipes.name: Ghee Roast Paratha
method_steps: Knead atta into a soft dough and rest.
Roll into rounds and layer with ghee.
Cook on a hot tawa until puffed.
